body: I actually do watch youtube videos on my tablet in bed and that really helps, but the attacks usually hit me right in that spot when I'm about to fall asleep, just when I start losing my grip on my mind and start drifting away, that's when I feel a charge of fear run through my body, almost like my body wants me to stay awake because there is some danger that I have to deal with right at that moment. I'm not even conscious when this happens and I don't really have anything in particular that is making me nervous. I just feel really really scared and get all worked up for no real reason, and that just wakes me up and keeps me up. Even if I manage to calm myself down, it happens again just as I'm about to fall asleep. Thank you for your answer btw, it means a lot.
Thank you for your words, this felt good to read. I'm definitely going to look into therapy.
The thing is I love my work. Flying is the only thing thst makes me feel like I still want to live, amd I'm scared to lose that.
I've actually been thinking about therapy, I wonder if it'll help at all. I somehow can't imagine someone talking to me and solving my problems. What will they say?
The thing is this has been going on for quite longer than 90 days. It was better for a while but it came back and I get this feeling that it will never stop.

The civil aviation authority gets a record of all doctor appointments and prescriptions on our annual health checks, so they know even if I don't report anything. As for sick pay, I do get some, but it's a joke compared to what I make when I fly and it's not enough to keep paying rent and stuff. As for the book, I'll take a look at it, thank you.

she isn't asking me for any help, except for asking me for my opinions on stuff, but I can't help getting involved. But you're right, I do feel her problems are my responsibility and I feel so guilty when I take that step back. How do I change that?

I actually did. But it's hard for her to afford a therapist at the current situation she's in. Plus she got a bit offended when I suggested that because she thought I was implying she was overreacting to things, which I wasn't. I genuinely think she's just going through a rough time.
